decisions.reason: As an evolved version of an already accepted trommel screen ('BASIC 518' to '518 FLEX'), it builds directly on our established screening know-how and the continued dedicated presentation suggests we can keep learning from the market and improve it further.

The mobile high-speed flail shredder fits closely with our core mobile shredding capabilities, and the 2019 Stage V update across the AK series shows enough installed knowledge and development capacity to sustain and refine the product.

The mobile high-speed grinder became more prominently presented in 2019, indicating that early market feedback was interpretable and useful, while the product remains strongly related to our existing mobile material-processing expertise.

Although technically related to our business, the stationary electric fine shredder disappeared from the website after its launch, which suggests weak market traction and insufficient learning payoff relative to the knowledge and development resources required to improve it.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder is highly consistent with our established stationary recycling machinery knowledge, and the continued standalone presence plus the claim of setting standards in the segment indicate strong absorptive capacity and good prospects for commercial improvement.
